_comment: POST /api/v1/auth/sessions/revoke-others (AuthEndpoints.cs, RevokeOtherSessions): ends every active session of the caller except the one the refresh_token cookie names. With no cookie (an API client) it ends all of them, unchanged. ONE outcome changes: success moves from an empty 200 to 204, for the reason of own-session-revoke.v1.json (contract choice C6, cross-diff review of 2026-11-01). Every child change's delta spec must cite these statuses VERBATIM.

revoked._note: Results.NoContent(), was Results.Ok() with an empty body: the console's client parses every success but 204, so the action reported a failure, kept its dialog open and left the ended sessions listed.
